headline: 'I am the house now': U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent Dares Investors to Short the Yen, as the Treasury Announces a Longer-Dated Bond Repurchase Up to $6 Billion - AOL
summary: The U.S. Treasury announced a longer-dated bond repurchase of up to $6 billion. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent also publicly challenged investors to short the yen.
why: The U.S. Treasury issues and buys back government debt, and its operations influence Treasury yields that anchor global borrowing costs.
why_moved: The Treasury's buyback of up to $6 billion in longer-dated bonds is aimed at lowering bond yields, and the Treasury Secretary publicly commented on the yen.
